approach: Read the slope of the line for the acceleration, then use the area under the v-t graph, a trapezoid, for the distance, which equals the displacement here.

steps.text: Find the slope of the line using its two endpoints.
The distance travelled is the area under the v-t graph, a trapezoid with parallel sides 2 m/s and 8 m/s and width 10 s.
The velocity is positive throughout, so the displacement equals the distance travelled.

common_mistakes.text: Treating the area as a triangle alone and ignoring the initial velocity of 2 m/s gives 40 m instead of 50 m.
